### Wisdom from the Psalms 2/4
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-2-or-4-552126.html
Passage: Psalm 15:3
Points:
- Diligent church service and external good deeds can be negated by gossip and criticism.
- True devotion to God must express itself in how we speak to and about our neighbors.
- Believers are accountable before God for their words and internal attitudes, not only their outward actions.
- Authentic spiritual growth requires honestly examining oneself rather than judging others.
